title: Small house on posts, from Jim's pencil sketch
description: An 8 by 8 ft floor on four posts buried 4 ft, walls about 12 ft, a flat 12 by 18 ft roof with a hatched hangover strip, glass high on the south and east faces and none on the north, and '630 BF' unverified. One tile is 305 mm, about 1 ft. The two readings are choices in the field sources: 12 ft as wall height, and the hangover on the south. The sketch does not give: the post height above grade, the glass sizes, any member section, the material cost or the build hours; the engine holds no null for a type field, so none of them is a field yet. The seed places the four posts only: the engine cannot stand a square floor on four corner posts or a roof past its walls.
